fixed_issues.description: Replaced hardcoded peak_memory_bytes (51200) with real tracemalloc measurement in run_scalability_benchmark().
Added status and event_count defaults in verify_audit_trail_endpoint so tampered audit chains return valid AuditVerificationResponse.
Fixed monitoring endpoints using require_recruiter_context instead of require_recruiter.
Passed opening_id into calculate_hiring_fit() to prevent SQLite foreign-key constraint failures.

pending_limitations.description: batch_process_resumes() processes items sequentially within chunks rather than concurrent asyncio.gather() tasks.
No OS/container sandbox isolation for untrusted candidate code execution.
